title: stochastic-lle: a validated stochastic Lugiato-Lefever benchmark
description:
A JAX split-step Fourier solver for the Lugiato-Lefever equation with physically normalized stochastic channels — quantum vacuum, thermorefractive, pyroelectric-electro-optic, thermal-carrier, pump frequency noise and pump RIN — together with the verification suite that makes their attribution falsifiable: exact-CW and manufactured-solution convergence, a pyLLE cross-check, hash-pinned golden trajectories, and a per-channel noise budget computed with common random numbers.

Every noise channel is opt-in and every default reproduces the deterministic solver bit-for-bit; tests/test_noise_off_identity.py enforces that against committed golden trajectories.
